categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Baosight Software Co., Ltd. primarily operates in software development and engineering services, service outsourcing, and system integration. Its business covers industrial software for manufacturing industries such as steel, non-ferrous metals, chemical, mining, and new materials, as well as automation solutions, robotics, smart transportation, and new generation information infrastructure services including cloud computing and data centers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages industrial internet platforms, artificial intelligence, big data, cloud computing, and autonomous industrial control technologies including PLCs. It develops full-stack domestic industrial control hardware and software, industrial robots with various payloads, and smart factory digital transformation solutions. The company emphasizes proprietary R&D, platform-based productization, and integration of digital and physical systems to support smart manufacturing and green low-carbon processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily from the steel industry and other process industries such as non-ferrous metals, chemical, mining, and new materials sectors. It also serves government and enterprise clients in smart transportation, smart parks, emergency safety, and environmental protection. The company supports large, medium, and small enterprises with integrated supply chain and digital transformation solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with headquarters in Shanghai and multiple subsidiaries across regions including Wuhan, Chengdu, Nanjing, and others. It also has a subsidiary in Japan. Its revenue is predominantly from domestic markets, with a small portion from overseas operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Baosight Software operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the industrial software and automation supply chain. It provides software products, system integration, and engineering services that enable manufacturing and industrial automation processes, as well as digital infrastructure services supporting industrial internet ecosystems.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on advancing industrial software, artificial intelligence, and autonomous control technologies to address core national strategic needs such as digital China and new industrialization. It prioritizes breakthroughs in key industrial software, AI large models, and PLC product development. The strategy includes enhancing platform capabilities, expanding SaaS services, and promoting green low-carbon smart manufacturing solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through software development and engineering service contracts, service outsourcing, and system integration projects. The company recognizes revenue based on contract terms either over time or at a point in time, depending on control transfer. It also earns from licensing, SaaS subscriptions, and platform-based service models including Robot as a Service (RaaS).
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Baosight Software is a leading domestic industrial software and automation solution provider in China, recognized as a national key software enterprise and industrial internet leader. It competes with both domestic and international industrial software and automation companies, with a strong position in the steel and process industries. The company emphasizes its autonomous control technologies and integrated digital solutions as competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 12.92 billion, a slight decrease of 1.78% from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 2.55 billion, up 16.82%. Total assets reached RMB 21.88 billion, with steady growth in net assets and cash flow from operations. The company maintains a robust R&D investment exceeding RMB 1.45 billion annually, supporting sustained innovation and growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Baosight Software offers integrated industrial digital transformation solutions combining proprietary industrial internet platforms, AI, and autonomous control technologies. Its products emphasize domestic independent innovation, full-stack industrial automation, and smart manufacturing capabilities tailored to process industries. The company differentiates itself through strong national strategic alignment, comprehensive system integration, and a platform-ecosystem approach enabling high-quality industrial digitalization and green manufacturing.
